_README: Per-locale documentation translation overrides, keyed by the EN source string. Applied verbatim AFTER DeepL in scripts/translate.mjs, so curated wording survives every re-translation. Add a "<locale>": { "<EN source>": "<translation>" } block; keys must match the trimmed EN string exactly. Product names and protocols are already kept verbatim by the PRESERVE list in translate.mjs — use this file only for phrasing/term choices DeepL gets wrong. Prefer fixing the EN source when a change should apply to every language.
